title: ISCC Content-Code Generator
description: Generates a conformant ISO 24138 ISCC (Instance-Code, Data-Code, Meta-Code, and composite ISCC-CODE) from a file entirely in the browser. Pure-JS engine (BLAKE3, xxhash, content-defined chunking, minhash) verified byte-identical against the official iscc-core conformance vectors, with an on-load self-check gate. The file never leaves the device. Client-side, deterministic, zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: iscc_content_code_generator
mcp_tool_definition.description: Generates a conformant ISO 24138 ISCC from a file: Instance-Code (BLAKE3 data integrity), Data-Code (content-defined-chunking similarity), Meta-Code (from title/description), and the composite ISCC-CODE. Pure-JS, verified byte-identical to the official iscc-core vectors. Runs client-side in the browser; the file never leaves the device.
